---
name: code-review
description: Use this skill when you're asked to perform a code review.
---

This skill is used to include specific review instructions when asked to perform a code review on behalf of a specific user.

When you have been asked to perform a code review on behalf of a specific user, read `./references/<username>.md` to apply their specific instructions. If a file is not present for the specific user, or you have not been told the specific user for which you are performing the code review, just complete your code review with your normal instructions and ignore this skill. Do not read any other files in the `./references/` directory.
